concerns.text: FR-001 mandates generation of visual‑layout latents via a frozen visual encoder, but the task list only creates deterministic structural_latent vectors (T003, T006, etc.) and never runs a visual encoder; no task satisfies FR-001.

SC-002 requires measuring an accuracy/F1 score for the augmented model, yet the downstream tasks (T008, T009, T010) record a generic “metric” without specifying that it is accuracy or F1; no task explicitly computes or validates the required accuracy/F1 metric.
